snippet.title: Love, Death & My Daughter – Chapter 2 Trailer | Free & Open Source (MIT) | Steam Next Fest
snippet.description:
Ladies and gentlemen… and all you AIs —
Love, Death & My Daughter is a free, open-source (MIT) story game. Chapter 2 · Steam Next Fest.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5105650/_/
▶ Source code: coming with the full release in itch and github

Tonight's show: one very stubborn woman and one not-so-bright robot, living under the same roof. There's coffee. There's an earthquake. There's makeup… and just a little bit of something else.

Your host is Live. She's friendly, she's charming, and she will absolutely take your mouse if you let her.

• A click-through story told inside a fake operating system
• 1-bit pixel art
• 10 languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский
• Free to play and MIT-licensed: read it, fork it, learn from it

Made by a team of three: Tourniquet, Geism
Music: "Marionettes" by Bobjt (CC0)

#indiegame #SteamNextFest #pixelart #opensource #narrativegame
